response.rationale: The pericardial mass invading the right atrium is the primary lesion, explaining the right atrial mass and extensive venous thrombosis (including hepatic vein and IVC) as tumor thrombus. IVC thrombosis is part of the thrombotic burden but does not account for the pericardial mass and right atrial invasion.
